title: Compact implicit high-resolution numerical scheme for multicomponent transport problems with Langmuir sorption
summary: We present a compact implicit high-resolution finite volume scheme for one-dimensional multicomponent transport problems with nonlinear Langmuir sorption. The method combines a second order compact implicit discretization with WENO reconstruction and a time limiter for the treatment of steep gradients and discontinuities. A special attention is given to the Courant number used in the limiter, where local characteristic Courant numbers based on the eigenvalues of the inverse retardation matrix are considered.
